editorial:
Imagine taking your family on a fun trip to the Grand Canyon, only to bring something evil home in your luggage. That is exactly what happens to the family in this story. You get to follow a group of parents and kids who think they are just having a normal vacation until their son starts acting strange. The movie starts off slow, building up a creepy feeling as you realize that something is hiding in the shadows of their house. It feels like a typical family drama at first, but it quickly turns into a fight for survival against a ghost that does not want to leave.

You will probably enjoy the acting and the way the tension builds up toward the end. While some of the scares are a bit predictable, the payoff is solid and keeps you on edge. If you love stories about cursed objects and family secrets, you should definitely give this a try.
endingExplained: The family discovers that the son accidentally brought home an ancient demon from the canyon. To stop the monster, they have to find the object it is tied to and destroy it. In the final scenes, the father fights the creature in a scary battle to save his kids. They eventually manage to cast the demon back into the darkness, ending the nightmare and allowing the family to finally be safe in their own home again.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves spooky stories about haunted houses and ancient curses.
